about: Free public government parcel services Field Scout reads at the moment a reader picks a field. Nothing here is a copy of the parcels; each entry is where to ask. scripts/probe_land_services.py checks every entry (fields, a test query, and that the service lets a web page read it) and sets verified and checked_utc. A county or state entry is used only when verified is true; Wisconsin's statewide map is builtin, tried even before the first check, and the page says so when it does not answer.

discover.note: A discovery pass searches ArcGIS Online for public parcel layers each county publishes, keeps only government publishers with a parcel number field and an owner field that answer a test query from a web page, and writes them under counties. Statewide candidates are checked first. Candidates are services found by hand; each is checked the same way and added only when it passes. Iowa counties are also looked up in the Big Ten Academic Alliance geoportal's record of each county's parcel service. Oct 18: also searched in ND, SD, NE, IN, OH, KS, MO and MI; Minnesota counties are also looked up in MnGeo's per-county folders (us_mn_co_<county>) and the gisdata.mn.gov catalog; refused lists services whose own terms forbid public reuse, which are never checked or added.

salesNote.MN: Minnesota sales are filed on the state's electronic Certificate of Real Estate Value (eCRV). The state sends its bulk copy only on request, so we do not hold it; the state's free eCRV search shows one sale at a time.
salesNote.IA: Iowa sales are filed as a declaration of value with the county recorder and assessor. We have not found a free statewide copy.
salesNote.IL: Illinois sales come from the state's MyDec transfer declarations (PTAX-203) on the Illinois open data portal.
salesNote.IN: Indiana sales are filed on the state sales disclosure form. The state publishes them free by year (STATS Indiana, from the Department of Local Government Finance); our copy holds farm sales from 2021 on, in the counties that have sent their forms.
salesNote.NE: Nebraska sales go on the Real Estate Transfer Statement (Form 521) and into the state sales file, which the state queries for the public on request. We do not hold it.
salesNote.KS: Kansas sales are reported to the state on a Certificate of Value. We have not found a free public file of Kansas sale prices.
salesNote.SD: South Dakota sales are kept by each county's Director of Equalization; a few counties post yearly sales lists.
salesNote.ND: North Dakota sales are kept by each county's tax director; we have not found a free statewide file.
salesNote.OH: Ohio sales are kept by each county auditor; many post transfer lists, one county at a time.
salesNote.MI: Michigan sales are kept by each local assessor and county equalization office; we have not found a free statewide file.
salesNote.MO: Missouri sales are recorded at each county recorder of deeds. We have not found a free public file of Missouri sale prices.
